snippet.title: HUNTRIX VILLAIN SONG - 'Demon' | KPop Demon Hunters Style Original Song | Animated Music Video ​
snippet.description:
HUNTRIX VILLAIN SONG - 'Demon' | Original KPop Demon Hunters Style Song | Animated Music Video ​| featuring ​⁠@LydiatheBard , @annapantsu and @anoravt 

STREAM THIS SONG 💿 - https://ffm.to/huntrixvillainsong.ODL

So I was obsessed with this film when it came out and have been dreaming about writing a villain song for these girls for FOREVER and the time is finally here! 

Written by myself with help from the wonderful Anora, production by the gorgeous Darragh, and vocals by myself, Anna and Anora, I hope you love it as much as we do!! 

Also this video?!?! Biggest hype to the artist @meijinn !! 

Now I’m sure you’re wondering how they became villains? Allow me to explain 

STORY
The Huntrix have saved the day! The world is safe from Gwi-Ma and Rumi has finally embraced her patterns and who she truly is. Everything has been set right and the girls can relax knowing the world is at peace! But not for long… Once the dust has settled, people start to look at Rumi differently. 

‘She has patterns just like those monsters that almost killed us all’
‘How do we know she won’t just turn on us?’ 
‘She’s descended from demons, what if she’s secretly evil?’ 
‘Can we really risk letting a demon with so much influence run free?’

Rumi attempted to live freely with her demon markings proudly on show, but a growing portion of the population grew afraid of her. It began as words of abuse, and trashing her online but slowly evolved to protests and coordinated attacks on her home. Rumi puts on a brave face but the shame that she had once dispelled starts to return, growing stronger than ever before.

Zoey and Mira notice this change in Rumi, and fight desperately with public opinion to show everyone not to be afraid. They go on talk shows, speak to law enforcement, organise rallies. But this only seems to make things worse. It isn’t fear that fuels these people the two realise, but pure seething hatred. snippet.title: Clayface | Final Trailer
snippet.description:
In four weeks, look fear in the face. #ClayfaceMovie - only in theaters October 23.

DC Studios’ “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the cult favorite villain from Gotham’s rogues gallery.

Matt Hagen’s meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss’s actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

The film also stars Naomi Ackie, David Dencik, Max Minghella and Eddie Marsan, as well as Nancy Carroll and Joshua James.

James Watkins directs from a screenplay by Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini, story by Flanagan, based on characters from DC. The film is produced by Matt Reeves, Lynn Harris, James Gunn and Peter Safran, with Michael E. Uslan, Chantal Nong Vo, Lars P. Winther, Paul Ritchie, Rafi Crohn and Trevor Macy executive producing.

Watkins’ creative team includes director of photography Rob Hardy, production designer James Price, editor Jon Harris and costume designer Keith Madden. Music is by Volker Bertelmann.

DC Studios Presents a 6th & Idaho Production, a James Watkins Film, “Clayface.” The film will be distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures and released only in theaters in North America on October 23, 2026, and internationally beginning 21 October 2026.
